notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights]100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif[/img]
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg[/img]
 
[i]To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug[/i]
 
Also, we’ve implemented [b]fixes for the “Dash”[/b] feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif[/img]
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

notes.title: Gocco of War Update & Special Sale!
notes.notes:
The new quests for Gocco of War have no officially been added to the game. 

Thank you to everyone who took part in our beta for these new quests! We are very thankful for your cooperation.

We have added the following 4 quests into the game:

[h1]Quest ex004[/h1]
Quest: Attack the enemy area while protecting your allies' area.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10637068/19d25a5557ec2a3a5094c1ba0859b11746b2be0a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quest ex005[/h1]
Quest: Guide an NPC ally to the goal while protecting them from adversaries. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10637068/164b19a43f2f9f1d1e4f3b70a0bef899a4cce040.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quest ex006[/h1]
Quest: Chase and capture specific monsters. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10637068/040bdec0616afb4ea43000fb7654454e58417fc4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quest ex007 [/h1]
Quest: Search the area for missing items. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10637068/6e2cf12db73340f53b5f46c009c682f1e7b1608a.jpg[/img]


[h1]Added 2 new weapons.[/h1]
These can be created by enhancing with drops from hidden monsters. 


[h1]60FPS Shadows[/h1]
After a large amount of demand, we have finally made it possible to display shadows even in 60FPS. 
Please note that depending on your PC's specifications, the game may run rather heavily in 60FPS. 
* It is possible to turn off shadows in the settings.

notes.title: Gocco of War 1 Year Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Its one year now that Gocco of War has been out! 
Thank you to everyone who has played and enjoyed this game, we are really happy to see so many people enjoy it over this year. 

To celebrate the anniversary, we have updated with all of the following:
[list][*]Removed Materials, Badges and Hairstyles from the ship inventory. 
* Please note, instead of buying hairstyles, all hairstyles will now be available from the start, including the new additions.

[*]Added New Items.
We have added 9 new items to the shop and 2 new male hairstyles to the game.

[*]Changes to difficulty
We have lowered the difficulty of the EX002 Quest

[*]One Year Anniversary Bonus
We have increased the badge drop rates and the gold rewards for quests 1-8 and 10-20! [/list]

We hope that you all keep enjoying Gocco of War!!

notes.title: Upcoming Update: 6/6
notes.notes:
Hi All 

We have a new update coming in for you all on Monday. 
Since we have been experiencing a variety of problems with file modding/hacking lately, we have had to implement some measures against it. 

Save data with illegal obtained data will no long be available. 
If you are currently equipped with items that were obtained illegally, please unequip (edit: you have to sell them) them otherwise we will not be able to help you save your save file.
You have until Monday to sort out your files.

If you find yourself getting an error upon launch, please verify your game files. 
Gocco of War → Properties → Local Files → Verify Integrity of Game Cache.

Also, we have updated the text in the Simplified Chinese Version. 

We hope that you keep enjoying the game, and we are always looking forward to more feedback on the forums.

notes.title: Gocco of War Update 3/30
notes.notes:
Happy news!!

Gocco of War has been updated! And with it comes a whole set of new features. 

Firstly, I want to say thank you for everyone who has been taking part in the recent events! Everyone who took part should be receiving the items in their inventory soon. 

Also we will be announcing the winners from all three competitions really soon, I want to do that in its own thread :)

Next I want to thank all the beta testers for helping us out on such short notice! [b]Please make sure you return to the normal version of Gocco of War!!![/b] (seriously, its really important that you do!)

So without further delay, the new updates includes the following: 

[list][*] A brand new quest! (Quest ex002)
This is an 8 player quest where you can take on multiple opponents. A protest is rising and it is up to you to stop it! 

[*]4 new weapon types! 
You can find a collection of new materials in Quest ex002 which you can use to craft these new weapons. 

[*]Some bug fixes. 
Getting past some doors without opening them. 
Bugs related to checking people's profiles.

[*]Compatibility for the items from the event.
[/list]

[h1]We all hope that you enjoy this new update and I look forward to seeing you all on the forums and online! [/h1]

Feel free to let me know if  you want to do more events and if so, what would you like to do?

notes.title: Gocco of War Update - 17 December
notes.notes:
[h1]Due to finding a large bug, we had to roll the update back to the previous build. We apologise for the trouble caused and we are working to get the update fixed asap[/h1]

The next update is here! This week we've implemented a lot of user requests.

[h1]12/17 Update[/h1]
[i]<Attended to a number of user requests>[/i]
[list]
[*]"Quest beaten" mark displays according to difficulty setting
[*]"Clear all Quests all difficulties" Steam Acheivement Stats have been fixed
[*]Added a page displaying all badge parameters
[*]Added a feature for raising costume ranking
[*]Badges obtained by beating quests will remain in the chat-log
[*]Currently equipped items now displayed in red
[*]Enemy elemental strength is indicated above their HP gauge
TIPS: Attack with the enemy's elemental weakness for increased damage.
Fire > Lightning > Water > Fire
[list]*Some enemies do not follow this rule
*No icon is displayed for enemies with no elemental properties
[/list][/list]

[h1]Final updates of the year scheduled for Dec. 21st-24th.[/h1]
[b]Main updates:[/b]
[list][*]Appearance of rare monsters in each quest
[*]Additional recipes for making costumes which can be dyed
[*]Additional lobby visuals
[*]User requests
[/list]
[b]Planned updates[/b]
[list][*]60FPS compatibility (coming soon!)
[*]8 player quests (sorry, will take some time)
[*]Mouse selectable UI (will take some time)
Please note that it is possible some of the above will change.[/list]

Thank you for all the help and feedback from everyone. We are always happy to hear your suggestions. 

[b]Lets continue enjoying Gocco of War together! [/b]

notes.title: Gocco of War Update - 12/9
notes.notes:
Hi all, super excited to announce today's update!! 

[h1]12/9 Update [/h1]
[b]<Attended to a number of user requests>[/b]
[list][*]Added a free roaming camera for taking screenshots in the lobby.
Options > Free Roaming Camera (camera can be moved freely around the player) 
Press F12 to take a screenshot
[*]At the shop, you can now sell materials, costumes, badges and weapons.
[*]You can now directly synthesize items from the "Book" menu at the synthesis shop.
On the "weapon"/"costume" pages of the Book, a mark will be displayed when you have all the materials necessary to synthesize a particular item.
[*]Added v-sync option.
Options > User request settings > turn V-sync "ON"
This will fix any tearing issues.
*Depending on the PC, this may cause the game to run more slowly.
[/list]
[b]<Other updates>[/b]
[list][*]By participating in a quest with a user who has not yet completed it, you will receive 1 extra lottery draw for a new badge as a bonus.
*To receive the bonus, you must have already beaten the quest.
*The bonus has a greater chance of being a high ranking badge (C～S rank)
[*]Added online lobby visuals.
Create lobby > "Town" can be selected from the lobby visuals.
[*]Fixed the bug where weapons remained in the lobby.
[*]Fixed the bug where screen remained black at start-up.
[*]Other miscellaneous adjustments.
[/list]

[h1]Future updates[/h1]
The final updates of the year are scheduled for 16th-21st of December.

[b]Contents of next update (in planning)[/b]
[list][*]New costume recipes
[*]Appearance of rare monsters
[*]Quests with up to 8 participants
[*]Additional lobby maps
[*]Miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Main updates to follow afterwards:[/b]
[list][*]60FPS compatibility（please wait）
[*]Additional lobby visuals
[*]Customization feature for costume badge slots
[*]Mouse-selectable UI (please wait)
[/list]
Some of these contents may potentially change. Thank you for your understanding.


We are working on the UI problem, we believe we have found the solution, its just taking some time to impliment, but I promise you that its coming. 

In the mean time, I hope that you enjoy our new lobby "Town". 

[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/Gocco/2015-12-09_00007.jpg]
[img=https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/playism/NOT-PLAYISM/Gocco/2015-12-09_00010.jpg]

[b]Thank you for the help, and lets keep having fun! [/b]

notes.title: Update Information
notes.notes:
Thank you for everyone's patience and support. We are happy to announce that we have updated Gocco of War. 

We have addressed a number of issues and requests that you notified us about.
[list][*]The game now uses cloud saving on Steam. 
Library > GOCCO OF WAR please right click and open "properties" 
From here you can update the game to enable cloud saving.
[*]Fixed bug affecting stats
[*]You can now open the communication menu after beating a quest.
[*]Fixed bug where player could not exit battle mode quickly after shooting.

For more details on the updates, please check the load screens in Gocco of War. 

We hope you enjoy Gocco of War

notes.title: SOLVED/ 直りました　[Emergency Update] Please Read / 【緊急告知】 読んでください
notes.notes:
SOLVED/ 直りました

[strike] （日本語下）

[Emergency Update]
To all users who have already purchased/played the game as of November 18, 20:00 JST

We have found a problem; the save data corrupts in the game update for this update.
If you are not playing right now, please backup your save data before the update!!
If you ARE playing right now, don't close the app and backup your save data!!
Even if you are not planning to play today, please backup your save data before the update.

So, please follow the instructions below to backup your save data.
"Steam client -> Library -> GOCCO OF WAR property -> Local file -> Check local file" to open your install folder -> copy "save_data.dat" to somewhere safe.
After you update the game, please copy it back to the original location.

We are very sorry to give you troubles for all the users who were waiting for this game and bought it right after the release.
If you have any concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us. 

----------

【緊急告知】
日本時間 11/18 20時時点でご購入済み、かつプレイ済みの皆様へ。

アップデートの間に、セーブデータが壊れてしまう手違いがございました。
ゲームを起動されていないのなら、更新が走る前にバックアップを。
ゲーム起動中の方は、ゲームを切らずにバックアップを。
とにかく今日遊ぶ予定がなくても、バックアップをしていただきたいです。

Steamクライアント→ライブラリ→GOCCO OF WAR のプロパティ→ローカルファイル→ローカルファイルを閲覧でインストールフォルダーを開いて頂き、save_data.dat
をインストールフォルダ―以外(Cドライブ直下にでも)にコピーして頂けますでしょうか？
次回更新でセーブデータが消えた時に、上書きして戻して頂ければと思います。

末尾になりますが、リリース直後に早速ご購入いただいた、
本作に期待いただいておりました皆様にご不便お掛けし、
大変申し訳ございません。どうぞ宜しくお願い申し上げます。[/strike]
